briefing.description: Elias Thorne was found slumped over his workbench inside his shop. His pocket watch was shattered, and a surgical scalpel lay beside his hand.
briefing.warning: This case involves a homicide scene.

victim.name: Elias Thorne
routine: 21:30 - Has evening tea at the desk.
22:10 - Conducts final check on the back door vault.
victim.otherInfo: Thorne was strict about timing and recently fired his apprentice over missing tools.

witnesses.statement:
Q: Mrs. Gable, where were you around ten o'clock last night?
A: Up in my apartment right above the shop, trying to read.
Q: Did you hear or see anything unusual?
A: Around 22:05, I heard muffled yelling coming from the back alley. A minute later, the heavy metal alley door slammed shut so hard my floorboards shook.
witnesses.reliability: Medium - Was in her upstairs apartment.

suspects.name: Julian Vane
suspects.alibi: Claims he was at the local tavern from 21:00 until midnight.

messages.text: He still hasn't paid me for last month, and he's keeping my precision kit.
Is the alley light still burnt out behind the shop?

suspects.relationToVictim: Fired three weeks ago after a wage dispute; dropped out of surgical residency.

suspects.name: Marcus Thorne
suspects.alibi: Claims he was working a late dock shift.

messages.text: The property settlement is final, Marcus. Stop calling.

suspects.relationToVictim: Primary heir to the building deed.

evidence.name: Broken Pocket Watch
evidence.description: Found under the workbench with shattered glass and hands stopped at 22:14.

evidence.name: Precision Scalpel
evidence.description: A surgical blade wiped clean of blood, left on the tray beside the workbench.

solution.closingStatement: Julian Vane slipped through the back alley door at 22:05 to confront Elias over unpaid wages and missing tools. Using his surgical training, he attacked Elias with a scalpel and shattered the pocket watch during the struggle.

briefing.description: Mrs. Jenkins' cooling tray of fresh cookies vanished from her kitchen window. Muddy footprints lead from the flowerbed toward the sidewalk.
briefing.warning: Follow the trail in the yard.

victim.name: Agatha Jenkins
routine: 14:00 - Bakes a fresh batch of cookies.
victim.otherInfo: Leaves her ground floor kitchen window cracked open on warm afternoons.

witnesses.statement:
Q: What were you doing around three o'clock this afternoon?
A: I was out on my porch watering petunias.
Q: Did you see anyone near Mrs. Jenkins' window?
A: Around 15:10, I saw Tommy darting out from her side garden toward the sidewalk, holding a cooling tray wrapped in a cloth.
witnesses.reliability: High - Clear view of the yard.

suspects.name: Tommy Miller
suspects.alibi: Claims he was hanging out by the park swings all afternoon.

messages.text: Forgot my lunch money today and the vending machines are out.

suspects.relationToVictim: Lives two doors down and frequently cuts through her yard.

suspects.name: Mr. Wilson
suspects.alibi: Claims he was watching baseball inside.

messages.text: Smells like chocolate chip next door.

suspects.additionalInfo: Currently on a strict dietary routine.

evidence.name: Muddy Footprints
evidence.description: Small sneaker prints matching youth sizes pressed into the flowerbed below the window.

evidence.name: Chocolate Smudge
evidence.description: A faint smear of chocolate left on the exterior window latch.

solution.closingStatement: Tommy Miller stepped into the flowerbed while Mrs. Jenkins was out of the kitchen, pulled the tray off the ledge, and ran down the street.

briefing.description: The front display window of an antique shop was shattered in the evening. A scuffed baseball was found resting among the broken glass.
briefing.warning: Review the physical evidence left inside.

victim.name: David Chen
routine: 21:40 - Silent alarm triggers at security desk.
victim.otherInfo: Had told neighborhood teens to stop playing street ball near his storefront.

witnesses.statement:
Q: Where were you when the alarm triggered?
A: Patrolling the east end of the block, half a street over.
Q: What did you hear or see?
A: Glass shattering at 21:40 sharp. When I turned the corner, someone wearing a dark hoodie was sprinting down the alley.
witnesses.reliability: Medium - Guard was half a block away.

suspects.name: Jake Peterson
suspects.alibi: Claims he was doing homework in his room.

messages.text: Mr. Chen took my league ball again and said he's keeping it.
Does anyone know if the security guard takes his break at 9:30?

suspects.relationToVictim: Frequently plays sports in the alley behind Chen's building.

suspects.name: Sam Wilson
suspects.alibi: Claims he was playing games online.

messages.text: Let me know if you guys are going outside later.

evidence.name: Baseball
evidence.description: Scuffed leather baseball recovered inside the display case, marked with hand-drawn initials 'J.P.'

evidence.name: Red Fabric Thread
evidence.description: A red cotton thread caught on the jagged edge of the lower window frame.

solution.closingStatement: Angry that his baseball was confiscated, Jake Peterson pitched his ball through Mr. Chen's display window at 21:40 before fleeing down the alley.

briefing.description: A commuter bicycle was stolen from the public rack outside the town library. The lock was cut straight through.
briefing.warning: Check access around the side entrance.

victim.name: Sarah Johnson
victim.otherInfo: The bike was a blue multi-speed model.

witnesses.statement:
Q: Did you notice anyone near the exterior bike racks this afternoon?
A: Yes, I was sorting returned books near the front window at 16:25.
Q: What did you see?
A: I saw Mike crouching beside the rack carrying a heavy canvas duffel bag.
witnesses.reliability: High - Clear line of sight from the counter.

suspects.name: Mike Rodriguez
suspects.alibi: Claims he was at the skate park across town.

messages.text: My bike frame snapped and I've got forty papers to deliver in twenty minutes.
Are the library side doors usually unlocked after four?

suspects.additionalInfo: Works an afternoon paper delivery route.

suspects.name: Alex Chen
suspects.alibi: Claims he was inside reading magazines.

messages.text: Still studying downstairs, text me later.

suspects.additionalInfo: Has a part-time job at a repair shop.

evidence.name: Cut Lock
evidence.description: Heavy braided cable lock severed cleanly with manual bolt cutters.

evidence.name: Green Fabric Fiber
evidence.description: Synthetic fiber snagged on the rack's metal joint.

solution.closingStatement: Mike Rodriguez pulled bolt cutters from his duffel bag, snipped the cable lock at 16:25, and took the bicycle to finish his paper route.

briefing.description: Fresh spray paint was discovered along the west exterior wall of the community center, signed with the tag 'SK8R'.
briefing.warning: Inspect the surrounding grounds for discarded materials.

victim.name: Community Center
victim.otherInfo: The center recently updated its facility usage policies.

witnesses.statement:
Q: Were you inside the building when the incident happened?
A: Yes, conducting hourly rounds near the lobby.
Q: Did you hear anything unusual?
A: Around 23:50, I heard aerosol cans rattling against the outside wall, followed by skateboard wheels clicking over the sidewalk joints.
witnesses.reliability: Medium - Heard from inside the lobby.

suspects.name: Kevin Lee
suspects.alibi: Claims he went to sleep at 22:00.

messages.text: The manager pulled my park pass for no reason. Total joke.
Is the camera on the west wall still out of order?

suspects.relationToVictim: Pass suspended by staff last week.
suspects.additionalInfo: Uses 'SK8R' as a handle on his notebook gear.

suspects.name: Jamal Williams
suspects.alibi: Claims he was finishing a studio assignment.

messages.text: Need to pick up more acrylics tomorrow.

suspects.relationToVictim: Enrolled in evening weekend art classes.

evidence.name: Spray Paint Can
evidence.description: Empty aerosol paint can recovered from drainage brush near the lot.

evidence.name: Skateboard Tracks
evidence.description: Urethane wheel tread marks left in dirt near the base of the wall.

solution.closingStatement: Upset about his suspended park access, Kevin Lee skated over to the center around 23:50, tagged the west wall, and tossed the paint can into the brush.

briefing.description: Twenty dollars kept inside a blue paper envelope was taken from a student backpack during third-period gym.
briefing.warning: Check hallway access logs during class hours.

victim.name: Emma Garcia
routine: 11:30 - Discovers money missing from front pocket.
victim.otherInfo: The money was meant for field trip dues.

witnesses.statement:
Q: Coach, did any students leave the field during third period?
A: Only Liam. He asked for a hall pass to grab his water bottle around 10:45.
Q: How long was he gone?
A: About five minutes. I logged his return on my clipboard at 10:50.
witnesses.reliability: High - Noted the pass time on his clipboard.

suspects.name: Liam O'Connor
suspects.alibi: Claims he only stopped by his own locker for water.

messages.text: I need twenty dollars for the library fine today or they're calling my dad.
Is the locker room clear around 10:45?

suspects.name: Chloe Bennett
suspects.alibi: Claims she stayed on the outdoor track the entire period.

messages.text: Hope we don't have to run laps today.

suspects.additionalInfo: Participated in track drills throughout class.

evidence.name: Blue Envelope
evidence.description: Torn paper envelope bearing Emma's name recovered from the locker room trash bin.

evidence.name: Security Camera
evidence.description: Hallway feed showing Liam entering the locker room doors at 10:44 and leaving at 10:47.

solution.closingStatement: Liam used his hall pass at 10:45 to slip into the locker room, took the blue envelope from Emma's bag, and tossed the paper into the trash.

briefing.description: A rare volume was removed from the display case in the special collections room. The cabinet lock showed no signs of forced entry.

victim.name: City Library
victim.otherInfo: Special collection keys are kept in a coded lockbox.

witnesses.statement:
Q: Thomas, did you see anyone in the archive wing around closing time?
A: Yes, I was setting up my floor buffer in the corridor near 17:50.
Q: Who did you see?
A: Mr. Harris unlocking the archive room door while carrying his briefcase.
witnesses.reliability: Medium - Saw him from down the main hallway.

suspects.name: Mr. Harris
suspects.alibi: Claims he left immediately after public closing at 18:00.

messages.text: A private collector offered four thousand cash if I can deliver the edition tonight.
Will the cleaning staff be in the archive wing before six?

suspects.relationToVictim: Primary custodian of archive cabinet keys.

suspects.name: Sarah Jenkins
suspects.alibi: Claims she was at the coffee shop next door.

messages.text: Grabbed coffee, ready to study for finals.

evidence.name: Key Log
evidence.description: Digital log record showing staff keycard ID 104 accessed the archive lockbox at 17:50.

evidence.name: Online Listing
evidence.description: Private marketplace listing created at 18:30 matching the missing edition.

solution.closingStatement: Mr. Harris accessed the key lockbox at 17:50, unlocked the archive case before leaving, and took the book to sell to a private buyer.

briefing.description: A prize rose garden bed was flattened overnight, damaging bushes along the shared property line.

victim.name: Margaret Wilson
routine: 06:30 - Finds trampled plot along side fence.
victim.otherInfo: Maintains flowers along the shared residential lot line.

witnesses.statement:
Q: Did your outdoor security light trip last night?
A: Yes, right at 23:45. I looked out my bedroom window immediately.
Q: What did you see?
A: I saw Robert stepping back over his side gate into his yard, holding a flat garden spade.
witnesses.reliability: High - Motion camera and window face the gate directly.

suspects.name: Robert Miller
suspects.alibi: Claims he was watching television all night.

messages.text: Her rose bushes are creeping under my fence again and ruining my lawn.
Is her back porch light turned off at night?

suspects.additionalInfo: Has expressed frustration over garden overhang.

suspects.name: Teenage Vandals
suspects.alibi: No specific timeline provided.

messages.text: Out on the street if anyone wants to hang out.

evidence.name: Boot Prints
evidence.description: Heavy work boot impressions pressed into damp soil along the bed.

evidence.name: Garden Tool
evidence.description: Flat spade with fresh dark soil deposits resting near the shed.

solution.closingStatement: Annoyed by encroaching roots, Robert Miller crossed the side gate at 23:45 and ruined the rose bed using his work boots and garden spade.

briefing.description: A purebred show cat went missing from an enclosed backyard. The side pedestrian gate was unlatched from the outside.

victim.name: The Peterson Family
routine: 17:00 - Yard found empty and gate standing open.
victim.otherInfo: The cat is registered for regional competitions.

witnesses.statement:
Q: What were you doing around four-thirty yesterday afternoon?
A: Riding my bike down the back alley path.
Q: Did you see anything near the Peterson house?
A: Yeah, I saw Linda loading a navy blue pet carrier into her car trunk at 16:30.
witnesses.reliability: Medium - Saw the activity from across the street.

suspects.name: Linda Carter
suspects.alibi: Claims she stayed home working on pet grooming.

messages.text: If their Persian isn't at the registration desk tomorrow, my cat takes first place.
Do they keep the alley gate latched when the cat is outside?

suspects.relationToVictim: Enrolled in the same competition circuit.

suspects.name: Pet Sitter
suspects.alibi: Claims she was at another client's house.

messages.text: Finished my house calls for the day.

evidence.name: Cat Carrier
evidence.description: Navy blue pet carrier lined with cat fur and salmon treat crumbs in Linda's trunk.

evidence.name: Security Camera
evidence.description: Street footage recording Linda's vehicle parked along the alley access path at 16:28.

solution.closingStatement: Hoping to eliminate her competition, Linda Carter unlatched the alley gate at 16:28, lured the cat into her carrier, and drove off.

briefing.description: A retail candy shop was broken into after hours. The cash register was forced open and merchandise was tossed on the floor.

victim.name: Sweet Treats Candy Store
routine: 20:30 - Owner sets door alarm and exits.
victim.otherInfo: Keeps small change float in cash register drawer.

witnesses.statement:
Q: Where were you when you made your delivery?
A: Backing into the bakery alley next door around 20:45.
Q: Did you spot anyone nearby?
A: Benny was standing by the candy shop's rear delivery door, leaning against the frame.
witnesses.reliability: High - Stationary delivery stop with clear view.

suspects.name: Benny Russo
suspects.alibi: Claims he was at the downtown arcade all evening.

messages.text: I need thirty dollars for my bus pass before tomorrow or I lose my apartment interview.
Does the rear door deadbolt still stick if you don't turn it twice?

suspects.additionalInfo: Knows rear entrance door latch setup.

suspects.name: Local Group
suspects.alibi: No timeline logged.

messages.text: Meeting up near the square later.

evidence.name: Screwdriver
evidence.description: Flathead screwdriver left on the register counter matching pry marks on the drawer.

evidence.name: Candy Wrapper
evidence.description: Specialty wrapper discarded along the rear alley escape path.

solution.closingStatement: Knowing the rear door lock was faulty, Benny Russo slipped into the store at 20:45, pried open the cash drawer, and fled down the alley.

briefing.description: A visitor's wallet was taken from his canvas shoulder bag while he rested on a park bench. The bag's side seam was sliced open.

victim.name: Mr. Henderson
routine: 14:50 - Wakes up and notices bag damage.
victim.otherInfo: Carries his canvas bag slung over the bench back.

witnesses.statement:
Q: Were you working near the walkway around two-forty?
A: Yes, trimming hedges right across from Mr. Henderson's bench.
Q: What did you see?
A: I saw Derek walk up quietly behind the bench at 14:40 and reach over toward the bag hanging on the backrest.
witnesses.reliability: High - Working directly across the walkway.

suspects.name: Derek Smith
suspects.alibi: Claims he was over at the duck pond feeding birds.

messages.text: My phone plan gets shut off today if I don't pay fifty bucks.
Is the old guy still taking his afternoon nap on the south bench?

suspects.relationToVictim: Frequent visitor to the main park path.

suspects.name: Jessica Miles
suspects.alibi: Claims she ran two laps around the outer loop.

messages.text: Just starting my run on the outer trail.

evidence.name: Cut Bag
evidence.description: Canvas shoulder bag featuring a straight six-inch slice along the lower seam.

evidence.name: Pocket Knife
evidence.description: Folding utility knife recovered with canvas fiber traces caught in the hinge.

solution.closingStatement: Derek Smith walked behind the bench at 14:40 while Mr. Henderson slept, sliced the canvas seam with his blade, and pulled the wallet out.

briefing.description: A student locker in Hallway B was opened during lunch. A personal phone and cash were taken.
briefing.warning: Check locker hall activity during lunch hour.

victim.name: Carlos Martinez
routine: 12:12 - Finds door unlatched and items missing.
victim.otherInfo: Kept his combination code written inside his gym binder.

witnesses.statement:
Q: Were you monitoring Hallway B during lunch?
A: Yes, I made my sweep around 11:50.
Q: Did you notice anyone near locker B-12?
A: Tyler was standing right in front of Carlos' locker, working the combination dial.
witnesses.reliability: High - Assigned to monitor Hallway B.

suspects.name: Tyler Jones
suspects.alibi: Claims he was in the cafeteria line the entire lunch hour.

messages.text: I need cash for concert tickets before presale closes at noon.
Are teachers monitoring Hallway B during first lunch shift?

suspects.relationToVictim: Sits next to Carlos in second-period gym class.
suspects.additionalInfo: Saw Carlos write down his locker combo earlier.

suspects.name: Ryan Chen
suspects.alibi: Claims he was in the library quiet room.

messages.text: Holding a table in the library.

suspects.additionalInfo: Has no access to locker combinations.

evidence.name: Baseball Cap
evidence.description: Dark blue baseball cap left on the lower locker shelf.

evidence.name: Phone GPS
evidence.description: Location log placing the missing phone at Tyler's street address at 12:30.

solution.closingStatement: Tyler used the combination he saw Carlos record earlier to open locker B-12 at 11:50, grabbed the cash and phone, and accidentally left his cap behind.

briefing.description: A sedan parked along Oak Street was heavily scratched along the driver-side door panels overnight.

victim.name: Mr. Thompson
victim.otherInfo: Vehicle was parked near the corner curb space.

witnesses.statement:
Q: Brenda, did you see anything on Oak Street during your dog walk?
A: I walked past Mr. Thompson's car around 20:25.
Q: Did you see anyone nearby?
A: Mr. Rodriguez was pressed right up against the driver-side door, dragging something metal along the side.
witnesses.reliability: High - Walking directly along the sidewalk curb.

suspects.name: Mr. Rodriguez
suspects.alibi: Claims he was watching news in his living room.

messages.text: If he parks his sedan in my curb spot one more time, I'm taking care of it.
Did Thompson go inside for the night already?

suspects.name: Teen Vandals
suspects.alibi: No timeline provided.

messages.text: Around the corner if you guys are out.

evidence.name: Security Footage
evidence.description: Doorbell camera video capturing Mr. Rodriguez alongside the driver door panel at 20:25.

evidence.name: Paint Match
evidence.description: Silver paint flecks matching the sedan finish found on Mr. Rodriguez's brass house key.

solution.closingStatement: Angry over the curb parking dispute, Mr. Rodriguez walked over to the vehicle at 20:25 and keyed the side panels.

briefing.description: Liquid green dye was poured into a backyard pool during a gathering, staining the water and filter system.
briefing.warning: Check rear patio access during the party.

victim.name: The Johnson Family
routine: 21:15 - Host notices green discoloration in pool.
victim.otherInfo: Side gate remained unlatched for guest entry.

witnesses.statement:
Q: Chloe, did you go out onto the patio during dinner?
A: I stepped out for fresh air around 20:45.
Q: What did you see near the pool?
A: I saw Mark walking quickly away from the pool edge toward the side gate, carrying a dark backpack.
witnesses.reliability: High - Saw him directly under patio lighting.

suspects.name: Mark Jenkins
suspects.alibi: Claims he was inside at the kitchen snack table.

messages.text: Everyone on the block got an invite except me. Unbelievable.
Is everyone moving inside for dinner now?

suspects.relationToVictim: Lives next door; was excluded from guest list.
suspects.additionalInfo: Has access to pool maintenance supplies.

suspects.name: Lisa Carter
suspects.alibi: Claims she stayed inside talking with hosts.

messages.text: Dinner setup looks wonderful inside.

evidence.name: Empty Dye Container
evidence.description: Empty plastic jug of concentrated green pool dye tucked behind side patio bushes.

evidence.name: Green Stains
evidence.description: Bright green dye residue on the soles of Mark's canvas sneakers.

solution.closingStatement: Resentful about being left off the guest list, Mark Jenkins slipped into the yard at 20:45 while guests were inside and emptied the dye container into the pool.
